# The winners-bracket team wins the grand final: no bracket reset. A walkover counts like a win.
teams 3
stage double_knockout
expect ready 2-3                   # seed 1 has a bye
play 2-3 2
expect ready 1-2
walkover 1-2 1
expect ready 2-3                   # the losers bracket: 3 lost once, 2 lost once
play 2-3 3
expect ready 1-3
play 1-3 1
expect state s1-GF-2-1 skipped
expect finished
expect placements 1:1 2:3 3:2
